trial_scope: Support-stand raw-motor diagnostic: ID7 commanded from its fresh center toward +1 degree over 8 seconds, with the other 11 axes held at their fresh centers; no standing trajectory or learned-policy command

id7.abort_reason: ID7 final raw step error exceeds diagnostic limit of 0.5 degree

operator_observation: The right-rear foot-side rotating member visibly moved; no abnormal noise, vibration, or snagging reported
interpretation_limit: Visible motion and the approximately stationary ID7 encoder report disagree. The amount and reference of the visible movement were not measured. This trial does not establish a completed one-degree joint rotation, a torque limit, or standing readiness.
